driverStandings.points.desc: the driver's championship points so far in the season, after this race (a season-to-date running total)

evidence.note: driverStandings.points is a SEASON-TO-DATE RUNNING TOTAL, not points in one race: it equals the sum of the driver's results.points over that season's rounds up to this race on 23,175 of 23,296 rows that have a race result (e.g. driver 1 in 2008: 10, 14, 14, 20, ... 98), and it never decreases from one round to the next within a season (0 drops in 28,687 consecutive pairs). The shipped description 'how many points acquired in each race' is wrong (checked 2026-09-30).

driverStandings.wins.desc: the driver's race wins so far in the season, after this race (a season-to-date running count)

evidence.note: driverStandings.wins is a SEASON-TO-DATE RUNNING COUNT, not wins in one race: it equals the driver's first places in that season's rounds up to this race on all 23,296 rows that have a race result, and never decreases within a season (0 drops in 28,687 consecutive pairs) (checked 2026-09-30).
